concept: Authorization through tx.origin: the original sender is not the immediate caller, so checks should use msg.sender
scene: Dark navy background with a simple call chain diagram: an owner node connects to an attack wallet node, which connects to a victim wallet node. An amber highlight marks the owner label that still persists at the end of the chain, with a white check line contrasted by a blocked amber line labeled msg.sender. Clean, minimal, technical layout with generous space for overlay text.
alt_text: Diagram of a call chain from an owner to an attack wallet to a victim wallet, showing that tx.origin still points at the owner while msg.sender shows the immediate caller.
